$comment: Mirror manifest. Every entry MUST point at the API owner's official machine-readable OpenAPI document, carry a redistributable license verified against that repo/file, and bundle to <= 7 MB. Entries are admission-gated at publish time: lint score >= 90 against ruleset/spec0-baseline.yaml. See README for the inclusion policy and how to propose an API.
